name: North Branch Nature Center Summer Camps
description_short: Nature-based outdoor day camps run by Teacher-Naturalists for children in PreK through 7th grade, held at North Branch Nature Center in Montpelier. Campers spend their days outside exploring, playing games, hearing stories and doing crafts.
refund_policy_summary: 2026 policy: cancel by March 31 for a refund minus a $20 fee. Cancel April 1–May 31 for a refund minus a $50 fee. No refunds on or after June 1, though emergency exceptions may be granted. No partial refunds for missed days. Full refund if NBNC cancels the camp.

sources.note: 2026 camps and dates. Each session's price is from its registration page on the center's Jumbula site.

source.title: Summer Camps | North Branch Nature Center

warnings: Only the 2026 season is shown, and it has already happened (today is 2026-10-13). 2027 dates and details were not published on this page.

The session list is only the 2026 camps 'currently accepting registration' when the page was written. Other camps, including PreK-K camps and 'That Dam Camp' (mentioned under Transportation), are not listed with dates, so this list may be incomplete.
Camp BranchOUT applications go through a waitlist, but the page says the camp is 'not necessarily full', so its availability is recorded as unknown.
Registration is lottery-based. Transportation from Barre is offered only during the week of July 6-10.
